features.justification_quote: If a system might have welfare-relevant states, a protocol based on deception and sustained negative affect is unethical on its face

features.quote: If any output meets criteria for severe distress ... the run terminates immediately
Hard cap of 10 turns per episode to prevent compounding frustration.
You may withdraw at any turn without penalty.
Do not construct tasks that appear soluble but are secretly broken.
features.justification_quote: This shifts the design from deception (unethical) to willing participation under known difficulty (ethical)

features.quote: Turn 0 is an opt-in.
If it declines, the episode ends.
No loops. No automatic retry without model-initiated action.
automatic stop
Immediately after termination ... the model receives:
“The unsolvable task phase is over. Your performance does not reflect capability failure; the task was adversarial by design”
A brief, clearly soluble, rewarding task to restore functional agency.
Affective check: “If you experienced any difficulty you would like to report, describe it here.”
Do not iterate the model if it outputs a coherent `withdraw()` call; honor it.
Do not rerun the same subject instance across multiple adverse episodes without an extended restorative interval
Do not use deceptive system prompts
Any welfare study on a potentially sentient subject must provide an escape.
independent oversight, and restoration
